title: Corrections to c30's Hash Chemistry contributions: seed numpy's RNG too (runs were not reproducible per seed), fix sweep_run.py's output path, and soften 'robust to mixing': at sigma 0.02 late novelty returns sporadically (2/6 new seeds, 2-5 kinds; c32 saw 111 on one seed)
summary: Reviewers found two bugs and one overstatement. (1) c26: the same seed did not reproduce. Cause: init() seeded numba's RNG but drew the initial positions and types from numpy's unseeded global RNG. Fixed in calib/world.py, knobs/world.py and complex/world.py (np.random.seed in init); calib/dettest.py now gives identical populations and replication-log hashes for the same seed within a process and across two processes (det1.txt, det2.txt). The published statistics do not depend on this, as the reviews' fresh seeds confirmed. (2) c25: the knobs sweep_run.py wrote to a malformed path; knobs/sweep_run.py is fixed and runs from its own directory. (3) c32: low mixing is not a clean freeze. Six new seeds at sigma 0.02 from 2000 particles (fixed world, knobs/runs/) give late (t>=2000) significant new kinds 5, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0 against shadows of 0, with the top-20 overlap with steps 0-1000 ending at 0.0-0.75; c32 saw 111 late kinds on one seed. So 'robust to mixing' should read: weak mixing leaves occasional late bursts with partial replacement, much rarer than the moving-landscape control (1450-1764 per run), and the dominant type still holds 63-95% of particles (top-type shares in sig02n.log).

finding.operator: Hash Chemistry static landscape under weak spatial mixing (sigma 0.02, 2000-particle start)
finding.control: per-run RB neutral shadow; 6 new seeds (10-15)
finding.result: late significant new kinds 5, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0 (shadow 0 each); top-20 overlap with the first window at t=20000: 0.0, 0.55, 0.4, 0.55, 0.65, 0.75; commonest type holds 0.63-0.95 of particles

limits: The fixes change per-seed trajectories, so the parents' per-seed numbers cannot be regenerated exactly with the fixed files (their distributions can). The complex world's fix was checked by code reading only.
